turns.question: What was the net revenue in the week starting Monday 5 October 2026, as non-cancelled order amounts placed that week minus returns credited that same week, even when the returned orders were placed earlier?
turns.answer: Net revenue for the week of Monday 5 October to Sunday 11 October 2026 was EUR 190.00: EUR 255.00 of revenue from non-cancelled orders placed that week, minus EUR 65.00 of partner returns recorded that week (returns count on the day they were recorded, so returns of earlier orders are included). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
